assignment_rule: Exclude the original 25 pilot and 132 prospectively assigned expansion tasks. Group remaining tasks by domain/difficulty in lexical order; sort each group by subdomain/task_id. Distribute round-robin to 14 batches using a continuing rotating offset. No response or model outcome input.

review_sampling.mandatory: Every critical RIU, every identified ambiguity, and every task-level language-equivalence/coverage check.
review_sampling.selection: Within each stratum of supporting RIUs select ceil(n/5), ranked by SHA-256(salt|batch_id|task_id|riu_id).
review_sampling.escalation: A systematic rule error requires review of every affected unit in the batch and other drafted batches, including units outside the ordinary sample. Log scope, rule, affected IDs, revisions and resolution; rerun validation and regenerate packets before independent acceptance. No silent frozen edits.
